build_lora_hooks: build LoRA hook closures for injecting LoRA deltas into any MoE runner at gate_up and down injection points
create_lora_info: create a LoRAInfo dataclass holding LoRA weights, dispatch tensors, and config for MoE computation
create_lora_hooks: create a LoRAHooks dataclass with optional after_gate_up and after_down callback functions
compute_lora_alignment: compute LoRA alignment tensors for the non-virtual-expert path using sorted token IDs and expert IDs
add_lora_gate_up_delta: add LoRA gate_up delta to intermediate cache in-place after gate projection and before activation
add_lora_down_delta: add LoRA down delta to intermediate cache in-place after down projection and before final reduction
